name: Qiniu AI
description: Chinese cloud vendor handing new accounts 3M tokens across 70+ models.
overview: Qiniu's AI inference platform serves 70+ models — DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro, Qwen3.5 35B, GLM, LongCat, Arcee Trinity and NVIDIA Nemotron among them — through both OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints at api.qnaigc.com/v1. New accounts receive 3,000,000 free tokens usable on any model, with no card; enterprise verification adds a further 12M. Individual developer limits are 5 requests per minute and 60 per hour, which is the real constraint rather than the token balance.
free_access: 3M free tokens on signup, spendable across the whole catalogue
No card required; real-name verification needed for a key
Both OpenAI and Anthropic request shapes at api.qnaigc.com/v1
notes: Chinese-language console and real-name verification. The platform also resells several closed models; the free tokens are general-purpose credit rather than a per-model quota.
